data.title: Backlog order is a fractional key per task (task.ranked), last write by ULID holds
data.why: Placing a task writes one event about that task only, so two branches that ordered different tasks never conflict, and two that moved the same task agree on the later ULID (I1). Equal keys from two branches tie-break by task ULID. Unranked tasks keep priority order behind the ranked, so a board nobody ranks behaves as before.
data.rejected: Integer positions: every move renumbers the tail, many events, each a merge conflict; Priority levels as the order: four levels are a sort key, not an order
